title: AIPPD: Ancient Italy Pottery Profiles Dataset
description:
21,782 whole-vessel profiles from 652 archaeological contexts of continental Italy, from the Early Bronze Age to the Archaic period (c. 2300–480 BC), ready for machine learning. Each profile was traced by hand from a published drawing (503 source publications) and is linked to its context, chronology, typological information, metric measures and bibliographic source.

AIPPD is Appendix A of the book: Cardarelli, L. 2024. Morphological variability and standardisation of vessel shapes in the 2nd and first half of the 1st millennium BC in continental Italy. A data science and machine learning project for the quantitative study of archaeological ceramic profiles. Adrias 18. Bari: Edipuglia. doi:10.4475/0840. This release repackages it in formats for machine learning (bit-packed masks, a parquet table, metadata, bibliography, the contexts as points), with a loader and AIPPA, the analysis library of the book, updated to Python 3.12.
